speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To understand the pattern of your double vision, limb weakness, and difficulty climbing stairs, please tell me: do these symptoms occur suddenly or gradually, and do you notice any drooping of your eyelids or slurred speech?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of double vision specifically triggered by looking up or down, along with fatigue-related weakness that improves with rest, is pathognomonic for this condition. REQUEST IMAGES: Cervical_Spine_MRI (to rule out structural causes) and Chest_X-Ray (to screen for thymoma).
